title: ℝ minus {0, 1, 2} has four components
caption: Removing the points 0, 1 and 2 cuts the line into (−∞, 0), (0, 1), (1, 2) and (2, ∞). Each is connected, and nothing joins one to the next.
alt: A number line from −1 to 3 with four open intervals on separate rows: x < 0, 0 < x < 1, 1 < x < 2 and x > 2.
description: Start with the real line and delete 0, 1 and 2.
What remains is four open intervals.
Each interval is connected, but the deleted points separate them.
